description: The name list here decides a CLASSIFICATION over request paths rather than over local variable names, and that distinction is the whole reason it works. An attempt to match credential-shaped local names was measured first and abandoned: across twenty clean repositories every match was a counter of language-model tokens -- token_limit, estimated_tokens, truncated_tokens. A request field called `password` is a password. The email in the second route is caller-supplied and is not a credential, and the CSRF token in the third is a credential the page has to read back anyway.

expected.note: a credential written somewhere durable outlives the request it belonged to
